Procession held in Barishal with blood-stained clothes of language martyr
2023-02-18T19:06:30+06:00 | Star Special
https://www.thedailystar.net/star-multimedia/news-multimedia/news/procession-held-barishal-blood-stained-clothes-language-martyr-3251311

The Language Movement began in 1948 and reached its climax in February 1952. The fight for Bangla as national language spread throughout the nation. That year, Barishal became the city of processions and intense activism.

On today's Star Special, we showcase the history of the Language Movement in Barishal.
